title: Contemporary semantic display palette

mapping.description: Deterministic color-only lookup. Infer nonnegative source-palette contribution weights for subtle raster antialias colors and blend the target palette with those weights. Out-of-palette artifacts snap to the nearest source palette class. Preserve the Euclidean RGB nearest-palette class of every source pixel after target quantization.
mapping.classDefinitionForRenderedPixels: Minimum squared Euclidean RGB distance to the three original dominant palette colors; ties follow class order cleanIce, debrisCovered, background.

sourceColors.method: nearest-class fallback for out-of-palette rendering artifact

interpretation: These are display variants of recovered rendered masks. They retain the source rendered-image approximation and do not reconstruct original model arrays or probabilities.
